tracks.title: This is How it Should Be Done
tracks.excerpt: For their collaborative full-length debut, Eris Drew and Octo Octa hunkered down in their New Hampshire cabin to craft a celebratory, sample-heavy tribute to the maximalist dance music of yore.
tracks.excerpt_zh: Eris Drew和Octo Octa在他们的新罕布什尔州小木屋里蹲下，为他们合作的全长首演制作了一个庆祝性的样品，向昔日的极致舞曲致敬。

tracks.title: Equinox
tracks.excerpt: British singer-songwriter NAO catches us pleasantly off guard with her soulful musical return on her new album ‘Autumn.’ The post NAO Offers An October Surprise With New Album ‘Autumn’ appeared first on SoulBounce .
tracks.excerpt_zh: 英国创作歌手NAO在她的新专辑“Autumn”中以其深情的音乐回归让我们措手不及。“NAO发布新专辑《Autumn》的十月惊喜首次出现在SoulBounce上。

Stonehenge is there, the Stanton Drew Stone Circles are there and Glastonbury Tor is there, all generating plenty of neo-pagan energy. tracks.title: Flor De Los Precipicios
tracks.excerpt: Modeled after the literary concept of the hero’s journey, the Catalan composer’s latest album is her most ambitious yet: It’s weirder, wilder, and more dazzling than anything she’s done to date.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这位加泰罗尼亚作曲家的最新专辑以英雄之旅的文学概念为蓝本，是她迄今为止最雄心勃勃的专辑：它比她迄今为止所做的任何事情都更奇怪、更狂野、更耀眼。

tracks.excerpt: No one is making music quite like PAINT, the project of musician and Allah-Las guitarist Pedrum Siadatian. tracks.title: Love's In Need of Love Today
tracks.album: Songs in the Key of Life
tracks.excerpt: Stevie Wonder marks the golden anniversary of his landmark album ‘Songs In The Key Of Life’ with an EP of rare, unreleased songs. The post Stevie Wonder Goes Into His Vault To Celebrate 50 Years Of ‘Songs In The Key Life’ With New 4-Song EP appeared first on SoulBounce .
tracks.excerpt_zh: 史蒂夫·旺德（ Stevie Wonder ）以一张罕见的未发行歌曲的EP来纪念他具有里程碑意义的专辑《Songs In The Key Of Life》的金色周年纪念日。《Stevie Wonder Goes Into His Vault To Celebrate 50 Years Of “Songs In The Key Life” With New 4-Song EP》首次出现在SoulBounce上。

tracks.title: 47th Street (feat. J. Ivy)
tracks.excerpt: Lalah Hathaway proudly releases her ninth album ‘Made In Chicago’ and leans into her past while looking to her future. The post Lalah Hathaway Reminisces & Radiates On ‘Made In Chicago’ appeared first on SoulBounce .
tracks.excerpt_zh: Lalah Hathaway自豪地发行了她的第九张专辑《Made In Chicago》，并在展望未来的同时回顾了她的过去。文章《Lalah Hathaway Reminisces & Radiates On ‘Made In Chicago’》首次出现在SoulBounce上。

tracks.title: Free Life (Vocal Version)
tracks.excerpt: Piero Umiliani’s Il Corpo is the sound of something beautiful beginning to sour. Released in 1974, the soundtrack finds the Italian composer in familiar aesthetic territory, where jazz, funk, psychedelia and library music bleed into one another. Sunny music for shady people, it embodies the anything-goes spirit of Italian library music, spinning a parallel film from grooves, fuzz and atmosphere. T
tracks.excerpt_zh: 皮耶罗·乌米利亚尼（ Piero Umiliani ）的《伊尔·科波》（ Il Corpo ）是美丽的东西开始变酸的声音。1974年发行的原声带发现这位意大利作曲家身处熟悉的审美领域，爵士乐、放克乐、迷幻音乐和图书馆音乐相互渗透。阳光明媚的音乐适合阴暗的人，它体现了意大利图书馆音乐的一切精神，从凹槽、模糊和氛围中旋转出一部平行的电影。

tracks.title: Psychic Video
tracks.excerpt: The UK selector throws caution—and genre—to the winds on an audacious 82-minute set that careens between ambient, drill’n’bass, post-punk, breakcore, and more.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 英国选择器在一个大胆的82分钟集合中对风投以谨慎和流派，该集合在环境， drill 'n 'bass ， post-punk ， breakcore等之间进行调整。

tracks.title: School's Out!
tracks.excerpt: The irreverent duo of Leo Fincham and Rowan Please plies its brilliantly digitized indie-pop bricolage on an album with the ragtag splendor of a low-budget musical.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 不敬的Leo Fincham和Rowan Please二人组合将其精彩的数字化独立流行拼凑在一张专辑中，并伴随着低成本音乐剧的破烂辉煌。

tracks.title: Low Times
tracks.excerpt: On his second album as Ghost Dubs , German producer Michae Fiedler pares his beats and grooves further back, reducing his already minimal palette to the stark rhythmic and textural fundamentals. But the tracks on Oblique resist the remoteness of some ambient dub — they might be skeletal, but they’re not bare-bones. The post Ghost Dubs :: Oblique first appeared on Aquarium Drunkard .
tracks.excerpt_zh: 在他作为Ghost Dubs的第二张专辑中，德国制片人Michae Fiedler进一步削减了他的节奏和凹槽，将他本已微不足道的调色板减少到严酷的节奏和纹理基础。但是斜线上的轨道抵抗了一些环境配音的偏僻—它们可能是骨骼的，但它们不是赤裸裸的。帖子Ghost Dubs:: Oblique首次出现在Aquarium Drunkard。

tracks.title: Goodbye to All That
tracks.excerpt: Torn between Texas and Topanga but fully herself, the songwriter sounds at home in the outlaw country idiom on an intimate, searching new record produced by Shooter Jennings.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这位词曲作者在德克萨斯州和托潘加之间徘徊，但完全是她自己，在家里用不法之徒的国家成语听起来很亲密，搜索射击者詹宁斯制作的新唱片。

tracks.title: All I Need (Intro)
tracks.excerpt: Victoria Monét wears her heart and her inspirations on her sleeve on her intimate new album ‘Frequency Of Love.’ The post Victoria Monét Tunes Into R&B & Her Influences On ‘Frequency Of Love’ appeared first on SoulBounce .
tracks.excerpt_zh: Victoria Monét在她亲密的新专辑《Frequency Of Love》中将她的心和灵感戴在袖子上。“维多利亚·莫妮特（ Victoria Monét ）调入R ＆ B后，她对“爱的频率”的影响首次出现在SoulBounce上。
